holes: Project identity may be wrong: brooks-history registry versus CivicState repo.
No production traction, revenue, or deployment metrics were found.
Government inbox deliverability may fail even if drafting works.
Official data coverage, especially local coverage, may be insufficient.
Legal-adjacent content may create manual review burden and liability risk.
mitigations: Require operator ruling before public business pitch.
Run paid beta with measured Stripe, Postmark, and official lookup outputs.
Keep legal advice, filings, lobbying, subscriptions, and public social features out of launch.
Instrument moderation queue depth and operator time.
Refresh stale planning files after validation.
residualRisks: Low-dollar transactional model may stay owner-operated rather than venture-scale.
SEO may take too long or fail to acquire qualified intent.
Compliance, chargebacks, or official opt-outs could make delivery economics worse than modeled.
